rule: Use forward-only numbered migrations; mirror approved validation ranges as CHECK constraints and model composition as a child table with an ON DELETE CASCADE foreign key.
bad_example: CREATE TABLE modules (credits INTEGER); -- no constraints, no foreign key
good_example: credits INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (credits BETWEEN 1 AND 20), calculation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES gpa_calculations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
provenance: C3 research team reviewed card (2026-10-20); paraphrases PostgreSQL documentation: constraints
